Name: Froggii's Better Weapons (Abandoned)
Author: frogb0ys
Description:
[center][color=#ff0000][size=5][b]Update 9/27/2026[/b][/size][/color]
 [/center]
[center]I finally admit it. This project will unfortunately never be finished. I've attempted over the years to pick it back up again and its always been met with pain. Drawing pixel art unfortunately gives me extremely intense migraines no matter what I try. The original project was done in the span of about 4 days before I realized that the reason I was incapacitated by noon was because I was doing pixel art in the mornings.[/center]
[center][/center]
[center]You can do whatever you want with these textures, I don't even care about credit anymore. It would be weirdo behavior if anyone lied about it but honestly whatever lol. Use these in your own mod, edit them, whatever. They need a new home anyway.[/center]
[center]
[s][size=5][b]Hello![/b][/size]


This is my first pixel art project, and I'm too impatient to wait for it to be fully finished before posting. I aim to completely replace the vanilla weapons with better, more aesthetically pleasing weapons, but for now, there are only 11 replacements. Keep in mind, this is not the final version, so there will be some adjustments to previously released weapons as I continue to update the mod.


This content pack may not play well with other mods that modify the weapons file, as I did a complete replacer using load, since I plan on replacing all of them in time, and didn't want to have to individually edit in each sword using coordinates.


Please do not claim my work. You can do literally anything with my redraws in the context of sdv modding as long as you credit me and don't put it behind a paywall. 


I really hope you enjoy it, have fun in the mines![/s][/center]
